notes.title: Major bug fixes and Single player made easier
notes.notes:
[p]We heard you! some people wanted the single player to be more accessible and we just did that now the early game in the single player level is much more balanced and have some safe nets to catch you if you slip.
Major bugs fixed in the game and lobby system. now you can easily join your friends with an invite code.
Networking code has been optimized resulting in a very smooth gameplay.
[/p]

notes.title: New map and bugfixes
notes.notes:
With this new map show off your dodge skills. Don't let them shoot you down and climb your way up to the trophy and show them who's boss.
single player had some issues with sound and music where sometimes music went silent and damaged the immersion. now turn the music up and enjoy your epic journey to the top

notes.title: Singleplayer Hotfix#1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45225202/8731697ba2efb408f389cdf90d50005cc7120edc.png[/img]
-Single player difficulty slightly nerfed to ensure a fun and less punishing climb for hardcore players as well as casual players.
-New Mouse sensitivity slider visible in the pause menu can help everyone to enjoy more.
-Cinematics are now skippable.
-Slight performance upgrade.

notes.title: Single player Release on Nov30!
notes.notes:
Get ready for an exciting new chapter in the world of our rage-inducing platformer! The highly anticipated single-player map, The Void Realm, is finally here. This massive new challenge takes players on an epic climb through a collection of fan-favorite biomes, each with a fun and unexpected twist.

Prepare to navigate fresh obstacles, master tricky maneuvers, and test your climbing skills like never before. While there are safe points scattered throughout to help you catch your breath, don’t get too comfortable—there’s always a chance of a misstep sending you back further than you’d like. Only the most determined will conquer the climb.

Are you ready to take on The Void Realm? Prove your skills and see how far you can go!
